To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
women who are more goal oriented and self-efficacious are more likely to engage in income-generating activities.
women who are self-efficacious, goal oriented and job involved are more predisposed to engage in productive activities that could help them out of poverty.
the psychological and economic factors are significantly correlated and that women who are goal oriented and have a high level of self-efficacy are more likely to engage in productive activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how women’s psychological factors such as self-efficacy beliefs, goal orientation and work involvement are related to women’s propensity to engage in productive activities.
the psychological factors that influence women to take up productive activities.
the economic and psychological factors that influence the level of productivity and income among women in Nigeria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
poverty among women in South Western Nigeria is a complex phenomenon that requires multi-disciplinary approach in addressing it.

women are not naturally predisposed to poverty and that the psychological factors that influence women to be productive and economically viable could be harnessed to reduce poverty among women in the society.
women’s economic empowerment and poverty eradication are inextricably linked and should be pursued in tandem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
women in Nigeria are not psychologically prepared for productive activities that could help them out of poverty and the government should take a more proactive approach in addressing this issue.

the findings of the study have provided a basis for the development of a model that could be used to explain the psychological factors that could be used in designing and implementing a sustainable poverty reduction programme for women.
women are more productive when they are goal oriented, self-efficacious, job involved and have the right attitude towards life.
The main takeaway from our work is that
women’s psychological disposition to engage in productive activities is a key determinant to their economic well-being and the nation’s economic growth.
women who are more goal oriented are more likely to be involved in productive activities and this has the potential to improve their economic status.
women in Nigeria are not only victims of poverty but also victims of their psychology.
